O1                                                                       (40 points)
Figure 1 is a whole sky star chart of Yanqing, Beijing at 20:30 tonight (UTC+8) with
the limit magnitude = 5m (m = magnitude). Four stars (about 1m - 3m) and one planet
(brighter than 2m) are missing in this chart. In the chart, the distance from the centre
is in proportion to zenith distance

(1) (20 points) Draw a cross (X) on the location of each missing star and mark “T” on
the chart, and draw a cross (X) on the location of the missing planet and mark “P” on
the chart.

(2) (5 points) Please mark the orientation of the star chart with “N” “E” “S” “W” at
the edge of the star chart.

(3) (10 points) On the chart, the celestial equator passes through many constellations.
Please write down the name of any five of these constellations (IAU codes).
